standard-dialogue-upstairs.npc: Hello there citizen. What can I do for you?
These stairs lead to the Ardougne Prison. It's home to thieves, murderers and everything in between.

standard-dialogue-upstairs.player: Sounds lovely. Can I go in?

standard-dialogue-upstairs.npc: I'm afraid not citizen. Only the Knights of Ardougne are allowed into the prison and I can see that you are no knight.

standard-dialogue-trying-to-go-downstair.npc: Sorry citizen. Only Knights of Ardougne are allowed in the prison.

standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.npc: Hello there fellow knight. Isn't today a wonderful day to be a Knight of Ardougne?

standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.player: I mean it's okay I suppose. The constant fear of some random adventurer murdering you and the fact that people are constantly picking your pockets isn't great. But hey ho, at least the benefits are good.

standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.npc: That they are fellow knight, that they are.

standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.player: Anyway, can I go down these stairs?

standard-dialogue-when-wearing-ardougne-.npc: Of course you can! You're a Knight of Ardougne! There is no place where you can't go.

standard-dialogue-downstairs.npc: Hmm... Is your head working okay today [Tim/Sue]?

standard-dialogue-downstairs.player: Of course, my head has never been better.
